basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old music enthusiast hailing from Chicago, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a deep love for hip hop, especially artists like Pop Smoke who have left an indelible mark on the scene. When I'm not working or browsing Reddit, you can find me crafting beats or writing some bars. I'm single and usually online during the evenings, especially after 8 PM, as that's when I unwind and catch up on the latest in music and design trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in the music industry, particularly hip hop. I've been an avid listener since my early teens, and I taught myself how to produce music using online tutorials and community forums. I'm also skilled in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked on various projects for local artists.
